title: Authenticated company overview
scope: Overview screen displays only tenant-authorized assets and accurately marks unavailable services

criteria.given: User is authenticated and belongs to a tenant
criteria.then: Visible asset count matches permitted asset API response

criteria.given: User switches to a different permitted tenant
criteria.then: Assets and totals from previous tenant are cleared and not displayed

criteria.given: Backend is down or session is revoked
criteria.then: No protected data is shown; clear error and sign-in recovery are available
No critical inaccessible controls or horizontal overflow

blockers: No deployed staging URL and authenticated end-to-end browser capture verified
No independently reviewed UI/API tenant isolation evidence
